name: Dough-Vinci
subtitle: Pizza & Burger
title: Dough-Vinci Pizza & Burger — Real Pizza. Real Smashburgers.
description: Dough-Vinci Pizza & Burger: freshly rolled pizzas and juicy smashburgers with crispy edges and melted cheese, all halal. Real Pizza. Real Smashburgers. Made with Passion.
tagline: Real Pizza. Real Smashburgers. Made with Passion.
strap: Great Food. Great Taste. Every Bite.
welcome: Welcome to Dough-Vinci, where delicious pizza meets unforgettable smashburgers.

From our freshly rolled, perfectly baked pizzas to our juicy smashburgers with crispy edges and melted cheese, every bite brings together quality ingredients, bold flavors, and a passion for great food.
Whether you’re craving a classic pizza or a mouthwatering smashburger, we’ve got something to satisfy your appetite.

halal.statement: All our meat is halal. No pork, no alcohol.
halal.detail: Our pepperoni, salami, sausage and bresaola are beef, and our tiramisù is made without liqueur.

contact.address: Commercial Drive at Kitchener Street, Vancouver, BC

faq.a: Find us on Uber Eats, DoorDash, SkipTheDishes or Fantuan. We don’t take payment on this site.

faq.q: Can I pick up my order?
faq.a: Yes. Choose pickup in any of the delivery apps, or call us and collect it at the counter.
Yes. All our meat is halal, and we use no pork and no alcohol. Our pepperoni, salami, sausage and bresaola are beef, and our tiramisù is made without liqueur.
Yes: the Mona Lisa and Mushroom & Balsamic pizzas, the Veggie Burger, most sides and both desserts.
Every dish lists its allergens and calories. Our kitchen is shared, so tell us about severe allergies.
Yes. Call us a day ahead for office lunches, parties and team events.
We plan to open on {opening}. The date is confirmed here and on the delivery apps before the first order.

catering.title: Feeding a crowd?
catering.text: Pizzas by the stack, smashburgers by the tray. Tell us the date and headcount, and we’ll plan the order for your office, party or team.

order_note: Pickup or delivery: your app, your call.

leonardo.line: The pizza is the art. The smashburger is the engineering.
leonardo.alt: A page of Leonardo da Vinci’s machine drawings in brown ink: a heavy timber frame with gears and levers, smaller studies around it.
